# Webmedy

> > Webmedy is a comprehensive EHR and practice management platform designed for healthcare providers with integrated patient engagement, billing, and interoperability features.

Webmedy, developed by Ardinia Systems Pvt. Ltd. based in Noida, India, provides a cloud-based Electronic Health Record (EHR) solution with practice management capabilities including scheduling, patient portals, telemedicine, and medical billing. The platform supports healthcare interoperability standards like HL7 and FHIR, with ISO 27001 security compliance.

## Key Topics

- EHR (Electronic Health Record)
- Practice Management
- Patient Portal
- Patient Engagement
- Medical Billing
- Appointment Scheduling
- Telemedicine
- FHIR & HL7 Interoperability
- Healthcare Software
- Patient Management
- SMS Reminders
- ISO 27001 Security
- ICD-10 Coding
- Payment Processing
- Healthcare Technology

- [Best Practice Management Software | Webmedy](https://webmedy.com/practice-management): Webmedy practice management with scheduling, SMS reminders, and payments

- [Billing | Webmedy](https://webmedy.com/billing): Webmedy billing, invoicing, and payment processing features
- [Security | Webmedy](https://webmedy.com/security): Webmedy security with ISO 27001, role-based access control
